name: Baseline_CNN
notes: Underfitting (train ~44%, val ~50%). Too shallow for 23 classes but 48.2% is 11x above random (4.3%), so it's learning something. Transfer learning clearly needed.

name: ResNet50_Transfer
notes: Frozen base gets 77% -- +29pp over baseline. ImageNet features transfer well to paintings. Train ~ val: no overfitting with frozen weights.

name: ResNet50_FineTuned
notes: +4pp over frozen. But 92% train vs 81% val = 11pp gap, overfitting. LR dropped from 1e-5 to 5e-6 at epoch 14.

name: EfficientNetB0_Transfer
notes: 5pp below frozen ResNet50. B0 is probably too small (5.3M vs 25.6M params) for 23 diverse artists.

name: EfficientNetB0_FineTuned
notes: Only +2pp from fine-tuning. Still improving at epoch 15 -- probably needs more epochs. Smaller gain than ResNet suggests the base features themselves are the bottleneck.

name: ResNet50_v2_FineTuned
notes: Strong augmentation + label smoothing. Same 78.8% as Phase 1, stronger aug didn't help. Frozen phase was worse (75.9% vs 77.0%). Train-val gap grew to 12.8pp. Random crop seems bad for paintings -- composition is a style signal.

name: EfficientNetB2_FineTuned
notes: B2 upgrade: +2.2pp over B0. Train-val gap only 3.6pp vs ResNet's 12.8pp -- B2 generalises better even with lower absolute accuracy.

name: Ensemble_ResNet50v2_EffNetB2
notes: Softmax averaging. 80.5% = +1.7pp over best single model. Different architectures make different errors.
